title: Protected read-only xlsx 001
notes: real sheetProtection (sheet="1", no password hash) via ws.protection.sheet=True, plus password-less workbook structure lock (wb.security lockStructure=True); A1 is the one locked cell (inherits locked=1 from the Normal cell style), A2:A3 carry explicit applyProtection locked=0 xf entries — verified in styles.xml/sheet1.xml. Password-less protection is a UI hint, not security; weakness is intentional fixture content, not a generator bug.
